feeds.title: The Milspo Business Network Blog
feeds.description: The Milspo Business Network is a global network that supports all UK military spouses, partners and other halves to build the business of their dreams. It's a mutual support organisation for SME owners, that provides peer-to-peer mentoring, networking and access to likeminded Milspo's at a grass-routes level.
